nom: SUNDAY RILEY Peace Keeper Acne Treatment Serum

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin describe salicylic acid as a must-have that leaves skin feeling fresh rather than heavy, though one review cautions the serum can leave a slight shine right after application on very oily skin.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report the serum layers well without adding extra oiliness and helps calm redness and texture from acne or rosacea when used as their only active.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin most often describe the serum as calming and non-irritating even on acne-prone or reactive skin, though several say it is strong enough to require spot-treatment use, every-other-night application, or extra moisturizer to avoid dryness or redness.

concerns.redness: Reviewers frequently report visibly reduced redness, including redness tied to active breakouts and to acne rosacea, typically noticed within one to two weeks; a couple of reviewers instead note the serum itself causes brief redness or a stinging sensation on application that fades within minutes.
concerns.dehydration: Reports are split: many reviewers describe the serum as mildly to moderately drying, especially with daily or all-over use, and pair it with a moisturizer or cut back to two or three applications a week, while a comparable number say it does not dry out their skin and some even find it hydrating.
concerns.spots: A few reviewers used the serum for post-acne marks or hyperpigmentation, including one treating hyperpigmentation on the face, back, and shoulders alongside a prescribed azelaic acid routine, and both report visible fading with consistent use.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers with acne report calmer skin with fewer, smaller, or faster-healing breakouts, often within one to two weeks of consistent use, and several mention an initial purging period before improvement; a minority report no meaningful change, and one reviewer describes a severe reaction with large, painful under-the-skin pimples that worsened over about a month.
concerns.oiliness: The handful of reviewers who mention oiliness say the serum feels light rather than greasy and layers fine under sunscreen, with one describing calmer, less oily summer skin, though another with very oily skin noticed a bit of shine right after application.

aspects.libelle: Chemical or medicinal smell for some
Elegant glass bottle with locking pump
Layers well under makeup and moisturizer

extraits.texte: This stuff made my face break out like it never has before! HUGE deep under the skin type pimples that hurt! I generally do not have sensitive skin. I thought I'd give it a month or so and it completely wrecked my face and skincare routine. I'm so sad because it was also so expensive and was recommended by an Ulta employee 🙁

extraits.titre: Solid Results, but Not a Must-Have
extraits.texte: This serum helps with active breakouts, but results aren't instant and it takes consistent use to see improvement. While it does reduce redness over time, it can cause some mild irritation if used too often, especially on sensitive skin. The texture is lightweight, but it can feel slightly tacky before fully drying. It doesn't leave a heavy residue, but I noticed a bit of shine after application, so it may not be ideal if you're very oily. The price is definitely high for the amount you get, which is a downside. The packaging looks nice and the dropper is convenient, but it's easy to dispense too much product at once. Overall, it works, but it's not a miracle product and may not be worth the price for everyone.

I received this item for free by I nfluenster and Sunday Riley to share my honest review. I have combo, ultra sensitive, acne-prone skin, and my pores are huge around the nose area and chin. I'm always looking for a product that helps me with the clearing of my pores/acne but since my skin is so sensitive I can never use AHAs or BHA without having a rash on my face or acne triggering reaction. When I first tried this product I had a lot of fears, I can definitely feel a tingling sensation at the beginning but no reaction or acne activation. I have been using it for a couple of weeks now, and I can see a little improvement with my acne and overall brightness of my skin. To clear out the pores I know it will take a while but I'll keep using it and I'll definitely come back to share my progress. I am so happy that I found a product that's so gentle on my skin but showing results with my acne.

Wow Sunday Riley never disappoints. This serum works incredibly fast and well. The bottle is a great size, love that the nozzle locks when you twist it. Upon first use it really dried up and shrunk significantly some bumps I have. I have sensitive skin, I recommend easing your way into it as it is very strong (I couldn't use this everyday) and also use it as a spot treatment. It really dries out your face, I made the mistake of putting it all over my face and had to use tons of moisturizer the next day because it dried out my skin so much. I cannot believe how fast it worked on some small stubborn bumps I have. I can't wait to see more results the longer I use it. This was an incentivized review.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Received for free. I have combination skin and texture + redness from acne rosacea on my face, so it's very difficult to balance between finding products that exfoliate to help smoothen my skin but aren't too harsh and irritating. I've been using this product every other day as my only active with no issues and while I still have some texture, it has visibly shown some improvement over the last few weeks. I also like that it does not have any strongly scented essential oils/fragrances, which tend to really irritate my sensitive skin.

extraits.titre: Made my skin feel brand new
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I had never tried a product from Sunday Riley before, so I was intrigued when I was sent this. I love a good salicylic acid serum. Especially one that's gentle on acne prone skin. I have super oily skin, so salicylic acid is a must for me. I loved how this felt on the skin, super smooth and calming on the skin. Also loved that it had no scent. It made my skin feel like brand new the next day after using it. I will definitely be checking this brand out for other products.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I normally take a break from actives and my dermatologist prescribed topicals during the summer time, especially as someone who deals with hyperpigmentation. Normally, I wear a prescribed 15% azaleic acid, so I was surprised to see an OTC product with near prescriptions strength with salicylic acid! This worked wonders not only on my face, but stubborn back and shoulder hyperpigmentation as well. I use it at night and follow up in the morning and throughout the day with sunscreen! Highly recommend!!
